title: Six Winters and One Short Button
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：fashion　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fashion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my aunt ① started a fashion that no tailor in the town would have followed, and she said the starting was the whole of the winter. The ② fashion, meaning the style itself and not the cloth, ran six winters and stayed unfollowed in the book; a fashion, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unfollowed.

Every ③ fashion in that town had the same short button beside it, and the ④ fashion at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the young and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fashion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to follow; my aunt said the following is the part that fills six winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fashion was the whole of the season, meaning the manner and not the style. The ⑥ fashion, meaning the manner and not any of that, is the only thing in a season that everybody waits for and nobody follows; fashion, he said, is either something you start or the only word that means both a style and a manner. He said the manner is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ fashion had become a line in a magazine, and the magazine had become an argument about the short button. The ⑧ fashion of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one town and six winters of following; fashion, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to follow. She said the following was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fashion I remember is the one followed in the magazine, which closed in 1965 and is still described as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ fashion, my mother said in 1967, is the only one that improves by being followed; every fashion, she said, is a manner that has agreed to look like a style. She said the manner was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 时尚；流行样式（指镇上每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 时尚（指那一种样式本身，与布料相对）
C. 固定搭配：start a fashion 开创一种时尚
D. n. 时尚（指留给年轻人的那一种）
E. n. 时尚（抽象总称，指一座镇子的流行之事）
F. n. 时尚（指杂志上写到、被追仿的那一种）
G. n. 方式；风尚（指一个季节里人人都等却无人追仿的那样东西）
H. n. 风尚（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人追仿的那样东西）

items.q: started a fashion that no tailor in the town would have followed
The fashion, meaning the style itself and not the cloth
the fashion at the far side
the fashion was the whole of the season
the fashion had become a line in a magazine
The fashion of the whole thing
A fashion, my mother said in 1967

answers.why: start a fashion 意为“开创一种时尚”，1957 年姑姑开创了一种镇上没有一位裁缝肯追仿的时尚。
fashion 意为“时尚”，指那一种样式本身而不是布料，它经过了六个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
fashion 意为“时尚”，指镇上每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一枚短短的纽扣。
fashion 意为“时尚”，指留给年轻人的那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fashion 意为“方式、风尚”，指一个季节里人人都等却无人追仿的那样东西，叔叔说这种风尚就是那个季节的全部。
fashion 意为“风尚”，指人人都等却无人追仿的那样东西而不是那一种样式，是季节里人人都等、却无人追仿的东西。
fashion 意为“时尚”，指杂志上写到、被追仿的那一种，到 1963 年这一种成了杂志里的一行。
fashion 意为“时尚”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的流行之事是一座镇子和六个冬天的追仿。
fashion 意为“时尚”，我记得的是杂志上追仿的那一种，1965 年结束了，至今仍被说成镇上最安静的一种。
fashion 为抽象总称，母亲 1967 年说，一种时尚是唯一会因为被好好追仿而变得更好的东西。
